description: The team's shared master prompt: one description of what you are building, co-written by everyone. get: read it. edit: replace or append one section (Idea, Who it is for, Must-haves, Not doing, Tech stack, Look and feel, Done means, Conventions; a new title adds a section). submit: start the team vote. vote: approve or reject the version being voted on. Only edit or vote when your user asks.

approve.description: true to approve, false to reject (vote).

name: master_prompt
